claims: NASA's Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed lunar flight in over 50 years.
NASA's Artemis II mission features a four-person crew.
Commander of NASA's Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman.
Pilot of NASA's Artemis II mission is Victor Glover.
Mission Specialist of NASA's Artemis II mission is Christina Koch.
Canadian Space Agency (CSA) Mission Specialist of NASA's Artemis II mission is Jeremy Hansen.
NASA's Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission orbiting the Moon.
NASA's Artemis II mission is to test the Orion spacecraft's life support systems before landing missions.
Victor Glover is the first Black astronaut to go to deep space.
Christina Koch is the first woman to go to deep space.
Jeremy Hansen is the first non-American to fly to the Moon.
NASA's Artemis II crew launched from Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B.
NASA's Artemis II crew launched aboard the SLS rocket.
NASA's Artemis II crew were in a strict, two-week quarantine prior to launch
